metadata.scope: ideal statevector, equality oracle, no correct-partition prior

variants.local_partition_diffuser: diffuser on the most significant data qubit only
variants.oracle_only: verification phase oracle without a diffuser
variants.label_before: copy partition bit to ancilla before data-only Grover iterations
variants.label_after: copy partition bit to ancilla after Grover iterations
variants.phase_kickback: ancilla in |->, controlled-X from partition bit before Grover iterations

metadata.density_format: each complex entry serialized as [real, imaginary]
